evidence: Implements BIP 330 Erlay transaction reconciliation across src/net_processing.cpp, src/net.cpp, and node txreconciliation modules.
rationale: Erlay is a major protocol upgrade that significantly reduces transaction relay bandwidth consumption and enables nodes to maintain more connections against eclipse attacks. While a major strategic feature for P2P transaction propagation, it represents a substantial multi-year protocol addition rather than an emergency or cycle-blocking fix.
